title: Ticket purchase confirmation
description: Confirm ticket purchase with event name, date and ticket link. Order confirmation WhatsApp template for events and venues.
notes: List ticket count and event date so the message is clearly transactional.

body.text: You're going, {{first_name}}! We confirmed {{ticket_count}} tickets for *{{event_name}}* at {{venue}} on {{date}}. We can't wait to see you, and we'll send a reminder before the day.
